<figcaption>Left panel, KDP Select Global Fund in millions of dollars as listed by the tracker — June 63.6, July 67.6, August 66.0. Right panel, the tracker's US per-page rate multiplied by 1,000 — June $4.615, July $4.221, August $5.170, printed to one decimal on the bars. Source: Written Word Media's KDP Global Fund payouts tracker, page last updated 2026-09-18, fetched 2026-10-02. Amazon's KDP Select Global Fund help page shows a different August figure, $69.4 million, under the heading "Total KDP Select Author Earnings"; it is discussed in the text and is not plotted because we have no source stating whether the two pages measure the same quantity. The right-hand bars carry a dashed outline to mark the second series.</figcaption>

<title>Kindle-edition rows by list price on Amazon's Mystery, Thriller and Suspense bestseller and new-release charts, October 1, 2026</title>
<desc>Grouped bars, percent of each chart's Kindle rows. Bestseller chart, 28 Kindle rows: 71.4 percent at 5.99 or less, 14.3 percent at 6.00 to 9.99, 14.3 percent at 10.00 or more. New-release chart, 33 Kindle rows: 57.6, 18.2 and 24.2 percent in the same buckets.</desc>

<figcaption>Method: a row counts as Kindle when its variant field reads exactly "Kindle Edition"; each Kindle row is bucketed by price.value into 0.00–5.99, 6.00–9.99, and 10.00 and up; each bar is that bucket's count divided by the chart's Kindle-row total. Bestseller chart, 28 Kindle rows of 50: 20, 4, 4 (71.4%, 14.3%, 14.3%). New-release chart, 33 Kindle rows of 50: 19, 6, 8 (57.6%, 18.2%, 24.2%). Exactly one Kindle row across both charts, The Silent Patient at $12.99 (bestseller #16), falls inside $10.00–$12.99; the other three bestseller rows at $10.00 or more and all eight new-release rows at $10.00 or more are priced $14.99. Source: Amazon Mystery, Thriller &amp; Suspense bestseller and new-release charts via the desk's data pack, captured 2026-10-01T05:30:00.845Z. Two Kindle prices with non-standard cent endings ($7.19 at bestseller #32, $9.40 at new-release #40) are bucketed as printed; see FOOTNOTES.</figcaption>
</figure>
